metadata.name: Friedrich Hayek
metadata.description: Austrian-born economist and political philosopher known for analysing dispersed knowledge, competitive markets and constitutional limits on power.
metadata.scope: Documented writings and public positions in 1944–1988. Modern scenarios are explicitly counterfactual inferences from those positions, not claims that the subject answered this quiz. Conditional answers retain competing principles. Assessment research accessed 4 October 2026.
